svg.aria-label: Transparent screw and a tracked water section
svg.title: Transparent screw and a tracked water section
svg.desc: Orthographic geometric model. The casing rotates with the blades. Rust traces one material blade. Blue is one section of a single bucket, not all the water. Each complete revolution moves this bucket one pitch uphill.

g.text: Rust: one blade. Blue: bucket cut and horizontal spill level.
